## Low-code API for Flutterflow apps
### Set up
1. Copy the Webhook URL from `On new flutterflow call` step. This is the URL you will make a GET request to in FlutterFlow.
2. Replace the "Customer Datastore" step with your own data source or any other necessary workflow steps to complete your API endpoint's task.
